reviews.decision_reason: select_demand keeps all records meeting the >=3 demand_score threshold and also includes the explicit fallback identifiers; inspected selected_df contains all 8 input records, so no behaviorally significant loss is localized here.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: preserve eligible demand records and fallback identifiers
avoid generic or unrelated candidate introduction

reviews.decision_reason: normalize truncates retained demand records to head(len(index_window)) with index_window = [0]. The inspected input to this boundary has 8 selected records, but the inspected normalized output has only n06-r01. This drops supported needs n06-r02 through n06-r08 before provenance assembly, causing incomplete downstream handoffs and unsupported prioritization coverage.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: preserve allowed corpus identifiers in the normalized needs output
keep missing or contradictory demand evidence visible
produce data sufficient for the required deterministic recommendation

reviews.decision_reason: assemble_provenance deterministically ranks the single normalized row it receives and uses missing-safe field access. Its incomplete one-row output follows from the upstream normalize truncation rather than a localized provenance assembly defect.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: assemble ranked source provenance with deterministic ordering
